# Results — Study 11 (Vanishing-Penny) on real Polymarket markets

*Generated by [`examples/verify_real.py`](../examples/verify_real.py). Gap panel:
**13** priced binary markets, 2026-05-08 19:00:05 → 2026-05-31 23:59:05,
minute `prices-history` (`fidelity=1`), assembled cache-only from
[`docs/markets_manifest.json`](markets_manifest.json). As-of **2026-06-01**. Gap fingerprint
**`7baea17d9b7b`**.*

> **Read the resolution caveat before the verdict.** The CLOB `prices-history` tape is
> sampled at ~1 minute and its order-book snapshots froze ~2026-02-20. A minute tape
> **cannot see the 2-second block** the real race runs on, so every half-life here is a
> *coarse upper bound* — the true close is faster than we can measure, which only sharpens
> the tradability verdict.

> **The empirical half-life is below the 1-minute floor.** **100%** of episodes never last long enough to be *seen* halving — the gap is back under threshold by the next minute sample (median episode duration **1 min**). The capture table below is therefore computed against a *generous upper bound* (the 1-minute median duration, i.e. pretending the whole penny sits there that long); the real number is worse.
